lines: You keep adding details to protect yourself.
But the more you explain, the less heard you become.
People start to tune out the message.
A simple answer can hold your truth.
Your value doesn't need a long justification.
Boundaries grow when you trust your words.
Respect yourself by speaking just enough.
Follow for more insights on speaking less, feeling more.
cta: Follow for more insights on speaking less, feeling more.
caption: Over-explaining can dim your voice. Save this reminder and share with a friend who needs to hear it.
